title: notifications item (NotificationItem)
description: In-app notification inbox per firm: NotificationItem(firmId, kind, refs, createdAt); id = eventId of the source event (DISENO S7 (b)(c)(g)).
$comment: Table notifications (per cell). PK = FIRM#<firmId>, SK = <createdAt>#<id>. AP-G2: Query PK (paginated inbox, cursor + limit). Idempotent: PutItem attribute_not_exists with id = eventId. TTL attribute ttl = TTL_notif. kind and refs members are defined in DISENO 3.8.2.

id.description: Notification id = eventId of the consumed event.

kind.description: One per consumed event: EV-22, EV-19, EV-21, EV-20, EV-05, EV-06, EV-07 (DISENO 3.8.2).

refs.description: References only (no state, no engagement content), members present according to the source event (DISENO 3.8.2).

templateId.description: templateId of the source event, when it has one.

publishId.description: publishId of the source event, when it has one.

engagementId.description: engagementId of the source event, when it has one.

summaryId.description: summaryId of the source event, when it has one.

ttl.description: DynamoDB TTL attribute, epoch seconds. Duration = named parameter TTL_notif (no value fixed in the docs).

version.description: Optimistic-concurrency attribute (CLAUDE.md DynamoDB rules; RF-067): every write is conditional on the previous value and increments it.

createdBy.description: Audit (technical, mandatory): principal id that created the item; system writers use the service-principal uuid configured per service.

updatedBy.description: Audit (technical, mandatory): principal id of the last write; changes on every write.

updatedAt.description: Audit (technical, mandatory): instant of the last write; changes on every write.

state.description: Constant ACTIVE; the item expires with TTL_notif. Lifecycle and who sets it: DISENO 3.8.2 (DEC-27).
